description: This file defines the SugarWidgetSubPanelTopCreateAccountNameButton class, which extends SugarWidgetSubPanelTopButtonQuickCreate. It provides functionality to generate a button for creating a new Contact from a subpanel, including handling permissions and populating form fields based on context. The class is part of the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM framework and is used in the user interface for related module subpanels.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelTopCreateAccountNameButton
classes.description: A widget class for rendering a button that allows quick creation of a Contact from a subpanel, with permission checks and pre-filled address and phone fields.

methods.name: getWidgetId
methods.description: Returns the widget ID, optionally with a suffix.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Generates the HTML for the create button, including permission checks and prefilled form fields based on the defines parameter.
